mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_auto_log WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND object_key = #{objectKey} AND result IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED') AND create_time >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_auto_log WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND result IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED') AND create_time >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_auto_log WHERE rule_id = #{ruleId} AND result = #{result} AND create_time >= #{since}

SELECT CAST(create_time AS DATE) AS "day", SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "executed", SUM(CASE WHEN result IN ('PARTIAL', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "failed" FROM ecom_auto_log WHERE create_time >= #{since} AND rule_id = #{ruleId} GROUP BY CAST(create_time AS DATE) ORDER BY CAST(create_time AS DATE)

SELECT id, rule_id, trigger_code, object_key, object_label, store_id, event_json, create_time FROM ecom_auto_log WHERE trigger_code = #{trigger} AND event_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
